decisions.reason: Bleaching tray blanks are established dental lab consumables aligned with the firm's core range, so they are likely to remain.
PETG thermoforming blanks support digital manufacturing workflows and continue to fit the firm's dental laboratory offering.
UV-curing lacquer is a niche consumable but still supports the firm's digital production and finishing solutions.
Custom hearing protection earmolds serve the firm's hearing-care retail customers and align with its custom-device expertise.
